brandMix.title: Revenue by brand
brandMix.content:
ZJLD sells four baijiu brands: Zhen Jiu (珍酒), the flagship sauce-aroma (jiangxiang) brand and historically the majority of revenue; Li Du (李渡), a mixed-aroma (jianxiang) brand positioned as the company's "second engine" of growth; and Xiang Jiao (湘窖) and Kai Kou Xiao (開口笑), two smaller brands concentrated in Hunan province.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): the 2023 PRC anti-extravagance campaign crushed high-end baijiu gifting and banquet demand, and it hit the four brands very unevenly -- Zhen Jiu's revenue fell from RMB4,479.7m (FY2024) to RMB1,921.3m (FY2025), while Li Du held up far better and actually grew in H1 FY2026 (RMB788.0m vs RMB611.1m in H1 FY2025). Xiang Jiao and Kai Kou Xiao, the smaller regional brands, fell even harder in percentage terms. Whether Li Du keeps outgrowing Zhen Jiu is the mix-shift the market is watching for signs of stabilization.

What to watch:

  • Li Du's share of total revenue rising as Zhen Jiu's falls
  • Any brand returning to YoY growth, not just a smaller YoY decline
  • Regional brands (Xiang Jiao, Kai Kou Xiao) stabilizing or continuing to shrink

volumeAsp.title: Sales volume and average selling price
volumeAsp.content:
Sales volume is total baijiu sold, in tons; average selling price (ASP) is revenue per unit sold. Together they decompose the revenue decline into a demand (volume) component and a pricing/mix (ASP) component.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): both legs fell through the FY2025 trough -- volume dropped from 24,827 tons (FY2024) to 14,653 tons (FY2025) while ASP fell from RMB285/unit to RMB249/unit -- meaning distributors were destocking (volume) at the same time realized pricing weakened (ASP), the double-hit of a demand shock plus discounting to move inventory. H1 FY2026's volume (9,698 tons) and ASP (RMB262.5) both ticked up versus H1 FY2025, the tentative stabilization signal management points to.

What to watch:

  • ASP recovering without volume falling further (pricing power returning)
  • Volume growth that is not just channel restocking after FY2025's destocking

zhenJiuVolume.title: Zhen Jiu brand sales volume
zhenJiuVolume.content:
Zhen Jiu sales volume is the flagship brand's own unit volume in tons, separate from the blended company-wide figure.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): Zhen Jiu volume nearly halved from 12,284 tons (FY2024) to 6,328 tons (FY2025) as distributors worked down inventory built up before the demand shock, then continued falling slightly in H1 FY2026 (4,064 tons vs 4,612 tons in H1 FY2025) even as company-wide volume stabilized -- so the destocking of the flagship brand specifically is not yet finished.

What to watch:

  • Zhen Jiu volume decline rate versus the other three brands combined
  • Whether Zhen Jiu volume troughs before or after company-wide inventory (see the Inventory chart)

channelReach.title: Distribution and retail channel counts
channelReach.content:
Total distributors and distribution partners are wholesale/distribution relationships; retailers and featured stores are retail points of sale the company counts directly.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): management reports these counts every period to argue the distribution network kept expanding through the downturn even as sell-in revenue collapsed -- total distributors rose from 7,635 (FY2024) to 8,993 (H1 FY2026) and retailers nearly tripled (3,334 to 4,970) over the same stretch. A network that keeps growing while revenue per outlet falls is a story about future capacity, not current demand -- it only pays off if volume and ASP recover into that wider footprint.

What to watch:

  • Revenue or volume per distributor (implied, not shown) -- rising counts with falling revenue means thinner sell-through per outlet
  • Featured stores, the one count that has fallen (1,097 to 908), as the more curated/premium channel

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.content:
Inventory is finished goods, work-in-progress and raw materials (baijiu ages for years before sale, so WIP includes maturing stock) carried on the balance sheet.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): inventory kept rising every period through the downturn -- RMB6,383.5m (FY2023) to RMB9,621.5m (H1 FY2026) -- even as revenue halved, because baijiu production and aging continue regardless of near-term sell-through. That combination (revenue down, inventory up) is the channel-destocking overhang: distributors are sitting on stock bought before the policy shock, and the company's own inventory keeps building behind them.

What to watch:

  • Inventory growth decelerating or reversing as a signal that production has been throttled to match demand
  • Inventory days (not shown) relative to history -- aging baijiu is an asset, but a sudden step-up beyond the normal aging curve is destocking risk

balanceSheet.title: Balance sheet
balanceSheet.content:
Shareholders' equity is assets less liabilities; plotted against total liabilities to show leverage.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): equity that grows only through revaluations or share issues is not the same as retained earnings.

What to watch:

  • Liabilities growing faster than equity
  • Goodwill share of equity after acquisitions

cashDebt.title: Cash and debt
cashDebt.content:
Cash & equivalents against total borrowings (leases excluded unless noted).

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): the DCF's net-debt bridge uses these balances at the latest balance-sheet date.

What to watch:

  • Net debt trend versus EBITDA
  • Refinancing dates and covenants in the filings

ebitda.title: EBITDA
ebitda.content:
EBITDA is earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation -- an operating-cash proxy that ignores capital intensity.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): read it beside CapEx: a business that must reinvest most of its EBITDA is not as cash-generative as the margin suggests.

What to watch:

  • EBITDA margin trend
  • Gap between EBITDA and operating cash flow (working capital)

epsDps.title: EPS and dividends
epsDps.content:
EPS is net income per share; DPS is the cash dividend paid per share. Both are in major currency units.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): the payout ratio (DPS / EPS) shows how much of earnings is returned versus reinvested.

What to watch:

  • EPS growth versus net income growth (dilution)
  • Dividends funded from earnings, not debt

fcf.title: Free cash flow
fcf.content:
Reported FCF is operating cash flow less capital expenditure. Owner FCF (from the DCF) further deducts stock-based compensation, interest income and lease principal -- the cash an owner could actually take out.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): the gap between net income and owner FCF is the earnings-quality question the valuation is built on.

What to watch:

  • FCF persistently below net income
  • Working-capital swings inflating one year's FCF

margins.title: Margins
margins.content:
Gross margin is revenue less cost of revenue; operating margin deducts operating expenses; net margin is after interest and tax.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): the spread between gross and operating margin is the cost of running the business; a widening spread with flat gross margin means opex is growing faster than sales.

What to watch:

  • Direction of operating margin over several years, not one
  • One-offs (impairments, disposals) that distort net margin

ocfCapex.title: Operating cash flow and CapEx
ocfCapex.content:
Operating cash flow is cash generated by operations; CapEx is cash invested in fixed and intangible assets.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): CapEx here is shown as stored (sign convention varies by ticker); the DCF splits it into stay-in-business and growth where disclosed.

What to watch:

  • CapEx rising faster than revenue
  • OCF that diverges from EBITDA

profit.title: Profit lines
profit.content:
Gross profit is revenue less cost of revenue; operating income deducts operating expenses; net income is after interest, tax and one-offs.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): the three lines together show where margin is made and lost between the top line and the bottom.

What to watch:

  • Operating income growing slower than gross profit (opex creep)
  • Net income far from operating income (interest, tax, one-offs)

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.content:
Revenue is the top line: what customers paid for goods and services in the period, before any costs.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): the growth rate matters more than the level; compare it with the DCF's base-case growth path below.

What to watch:

  • Acceleration or deceleration in YoY growth
  • Whether growth is organic or acquired
  • Interim rows show seasonality

sbc.title: Stock-based compensation and share count
sbc.content:
Stock-based comp is the expense of equity awards; shares outstanding shows the dilution it causes net of buybacks.

For ZJLD Group Inc (珍酒李渡集團有限公司): the DCF charges SBC as a cash cost and holds the share count flat, so this chart is the check on that assumption.

What to watch:

  • Share count rising while buybacks are advertised
  • SBC as a percentage of revenue
